title: inline-script-guard — inline script summary
description: Structured summary of an inline Python or Ruby script embedded in a shell command. Produced by `llm` (codex --output-schema) for the inline-script-guard PreToolUse hook, which renders it into a permission prompt. Strict-mode shaped: every property required, object closed.

summary.description: One sentence, plain English: what the embedded script does.

writes_files.description: True if the script creates, modifies, or appends to any file.

deletes.description: True if the script removes files or directories, or truncates data.

network.description: True if the script opens sockets, makes HTTP(S) requests, or otherwise uses the network.

spawns_processes.description: True if the script shells out — os.system, subprocess, Kernel#system, %x, backticks, exec.

reads_sensitive.description: True if the script reads environment variables, credential files, SSH keys, or comparable secrets.

risk_notes.description: Anything else worth flagging before a human approves the command; empty string if nothing notable.
